title: drop leaves other items' relates_to and depends_on naming the dropped item
goal: backlog.py drop removes the dropped item's id from every remaining item's relates_to (and from a depends_on of an item outside its sprint's chain, as close does), and the gate do entries that name it, so check finds no link to an item that does not exist; found when dropping EP-v56iwyry left EP-auko2fyn's relates_to naming it and check refused (fixed by hand at f207182f).

run: import sys,inspect;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_items;sys.exit(1 if 'relates_to' not in inspect.getsource(bl_items.cmd_drop) else 0)
